decisions.reason: As a small accessory closely tied to the trailer business and service network, it is still worth retaining, though it is easier to discontinue than a full vehicle line if turnover is modest.
A box car trailer series remains a core product for a German trailer maker serving broad private and professional hauling needs, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn absent clear underperformance.
The car transporter trailer line fits the firm's capabilities and customer base, but its more specialized niche makes it somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning than the main trailer ranges.
Low-bed trailers support the firm's positioning as a reliable supplier for varied transport tasks and therefore should stay in the range unless demand weakens materially.
High trailer covers complement the trailer portfolio well and support cross-selling, although accessory-type ranges are somewhat easier to streamline than core trailer models.

Because this second box car trailer series appears to overlap with another core box trailer line, portfolio simplification and concentration of production and sales resources now make withdrawal more likely than continuation.
